open_risks: Operational health routes reject requests carrying tunnel/proxy forwarding headers by design (SecurityConfiguration.directProbeOnly()). GET /health/ready correctly returns HTTP 401 through the public tunnel; GET /health and the POST /v1/requests cases pass. Confirmed from both Person One's Mac/iPhone and, on 2026-09-22, Person Two's own Windows PC — the ADR-005 deferral for her own-machine API run is resolved.

AWS staging is deferred (ADR-004) — no budget available right now, even for the near-$0/month minimal design in docs/runbooks/aws-staging-setup.md. The Phase 0 connected checkpoint uses a cloudflared Quick Tunnel instead; revisit AWS no later than Phase 3, when Twilio needs a stable (non-rotating) webhook URL a Quick Tunnel can't provide.

Backend has no Redis dependency or Redis readiness check, even though infra/compose.yml and docker-compose.yml provision Redis. Either wire it in when something actually needs it, or drop it from Compose — don't let 'provisioned but unused' stand as if it were tested.
